verdict: CONCERN: 1 blocker (outcome classification still returns 'failed' for ambiguous 200 bodies)

findings.issue: 'failed' (execute -> finalize failed, release=True; 'failed' not in DUPLICATE_GUARD_STATUSES) is returned for AMBIGUOUS 200s. (a) data/entry ErrorMessage of 0, False, {}, [], 0.0, 'null', 'None' (non-blank after str()) with a PaymentReferenceNumber and Status Processed => failed. (b) _FAIL_WORDS substring match on Status: 'Processed - no errors', 'Successful, not declined' => failed. (c) mixed entries [ok, failed] => failed although one transfer succeeded. Money may have moved, reservation released, re-instruction not blocked => duplicate payment + cap bypass. Only a non-empty STRING message / positive status should be definite; everything else with a reference should be unknown.
findings.fix: Treat ErrorMessage as definite only if isinstance str and non-blank and not in {'null','none','false','0'}; non-str truthy-ish or falsy non-None => unknown. Negation-aware status (or match only exact status words). Mixed success+failed => unknown.
